build_mlpmaskdecoder: build an MLPMaskDecoder to generate mask proposals and attention biases from query and visual features
build_sideadapternetwork: build a SideAdapterNetwork to encode images with CLIP features and predict mask proposals via transformer layers
build_recwithattnbias: build a RecWithAttnbias module to recognize mask categories by applying attention biases to CLIP transformer layers
build_sideadaptercliphead: build a SideAdapterCLIPHead decode head for open-vocabulary semantic segmentation using a side adapter network and CLIP
review_mlpmaskdecoder_forward: review the MLPMaskDecoder forward method to understand how query and pixel features produce mask predictions and attention bias
